theme.name: neuroexplora_v3
theme.title: Neuro Explora v3
theme.author: Custom Theme — Misión Cerebro
theme.description:
Retro Cyberpunk dark theme for Neuro Explora v3. Full pixel typography, HUD cards, game intro screen, mission progress bar, terminal headings, and custom neuro icons. Dark background, pink/red accent colors (#ff5c7a), teal highlights (#00d4ff). Inspired by Misión Cerebro: Exploradores de la Mente.
Fonts: Press Start 2P (Google Fonts, OFL), Share Tech Mono (Google Fonts, OFL), Inter (Rasmus Andersson, SIL OFL). iDevice icons by Google (https://fonts.google.com/icons), Apache License 2.0.
